rule.description: For every struct the crate defines, collect its inherent methods; connect two methods when they share a root self-field or one calls the other (`self.m(..)` / `Self::m(..)`); flag the struct when at least 4 of the resulting connected clusters each contain 2 or more methods (an LCOM4-style partition into disconnected responsibilities).

checks.description: Detects a single struct whose inherent methods partition into several mutually disconnected responsibility clusters, each anchored on its own slice of the struct's state or on its own internal call family.
checks.detected_relation: native::Context (src/native.rs) owns six method groups that share no state and never call into each other, spanning six device responsibilities across three files
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: loader-registry, parser, capability registry, cache, callback owner, and sizing helper coexist on one class; no single cohesive responsibility names the type, and every cluster can change without the others noticing.

matches.evidence: `Context` owns 6 disconnected clusters of inherent methods (src/native.rs, struct definition): cluster 1 = pixel_component_count, pixel_component_bytes, tight_pixel_buffer_size (impl block in src/lib.rs, addresses E12-E14); cluster 2 (state `version`) = parse_version_string, refresh_version_from_string, supports_extension_indexing_queries (E2-E4, with the donor entry E15 in src/version.rs forwarding its parse through the context); cluster 3 (state `extensions`) = collect_indexed_extension_names, collect_legacy_extension_names, extension_names_contain (E5-E7); cluster 4 (state `max_label_length`) = refresh_device_label_limit, device_label_limit (E8-E9); cluster 5 = the two construction factories from_loader_function_cstr, from_loader_function, which orchestrate the absorbed population methods at creation time; cluster 6 (state `raw` debug callback pointer) = install_debug_callback, release_debug_callback (E10-E11).

excluded.reason: The loaded function-table struct is surveyed under the same rule; its methods form one connected initialization component rather than several disconnected responsibility clusters, so it does not represent this smell relation.
The version value's parsing entry participates in the relation as the absorbed-role donor (entry E15), but the struct itself owns one cohesive responsibility and is not flagged by the rule.
Targets a different platform backend; the identical roles behind the wasm loader would repeat already-covered responsibilities and its code is not compiled by the analysis run on this host.

excluded.candidate: command shims and GL object wrappers (src/gl46.rs and the name-wrapper types in src/native.rs)
excluded.reason: Stateless per-command shims and single-responsibility wrappers; their methods do not partition into disconnected state-anchored clusters.
